package.name: fsc_perception
package.description: Ground-truth line-of-sight source for the IBVS NMPC. Computes the bearing quaternion f1 and range r1 (matching pose_track_mpc_gimbal conventions) from drone odometry, the target's ground-truth pose, and the gimbal tilt, and publishes fsc_vision_msgs/TargetBearing. Also ships the gz gimbal + bbox ground-truth assets and the ros_gz_bridge config.
